The '''Auspex''' Discipline grants supernatural senses.

==Overview==
Auspex is a potent double sword that lets Kindred sift truth from lies.

==Official Abilities==
===Standard Powers===
* {{dot|1}} {{ref|lvl1}}
** '''Heightened Senses''': Raise your five senses to superhuman levels
** '''Ancestors' Vigilance''': Raise one sense and perceive [[Ghost (WOD)|ghosts]]
* {{dot|3}} {{ref|lvl3}}
** '''The Spirit's Touch''': Learn something of an object from its resonance

===Advanced Powers===
* {{dot|6}} {{ref|lvl6}}
** '''Precognition''': Glimpse a possible future
